coverage.comparator_keys: MATCH: all three decision surfaces of compareFinalOrder (entry-first cc:712-713, RETURN-last cc:717-728 including both null-lastOp arms, index cc:729) project identically on both sides across the five cases
coverage.size_guard: MATCH: single-element lists skip the sort on both sides (block.hh:431)
coverage.tie_behavior: MATCH: two RETURN-ending blocks tie in both directions (cc:719+724 both false); libstdc++ std::sort's insertion-sort phase (threshold 16, stable for ties) and Rugra's stable sort_by keep the pre-sort relative order on every case
coverage.wrapper_virtual_dispatch: MATCH: BlockGoto::lastOp (cc:562) and BlockMultiGoto::lastOp (cc:590) delegate through the wrapped component (Rugra: the `wrapped` field overrides added with this lane) and drive the composite's sort position identically

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: entry_first_return_last: entry (index 0) mid-list with two RETURN-ending blocks ahead of it — cc:712-713 entry key, cc:717-728 return-last key, cc:729 index key, stable tie between the two RETURN blocks (libstdc++ insertion sort keeps pre-sort order for ranges <= 16; Rust stable sort identical)
null_vs_return_arms: (null, RETURN) / (RETURN, null) / (null, non-RETURN) arms with an entry whose lastOp is null
goto_wrapped_lastop: real BlockGoto (newBlockGoto cc:1704-1716) wrapping a RETURN-ending block — BlockGoto::lastOp (cc:562) delegation sorts the composite to the tail
multigoto_wrapped_lastop: real BlockMultiGoto (newBlockMultiGoto cc:1719-1754) wrapping a non-RETURN block — cc:590 delegation sorts it by index ahead of a RETURN-ending sibling
single_block_skip: one-element list is left untouched (block.hh:431 list.size()!=1 guard)

observation_schema.format: per case: 'case <name>', one '<pos> name=bN idx=<i> type=<typename> lastop=<R|n|->' line per list entry, then 'end'
observation_schema.normalization: block identity prints as creation-order names (bN), never pointers; wrapper composites are pushed to created on both sides for stable naming; lastop prints as the comparator's three arms (R/n/-)

residual_diffs.evidence: order_blocks tie note (src/block.rs); A/B sha256 equality before/after on curl 124/124 and httpd 29/29
residual_diffs.summary: ranges with MORE than 16 top-level components: libstdc++ introsort permutes comparator ties (multiple RETURN-ending blocks) through its quicksort partition phase; Rugra's stable sort_by always keeps pre-sort order. No such function exists in the curl/httpd corpora today (every function collapses to a single top-level component, so the block.hh:431 guard skips the sort — verified byte-identical A/B), and the oracle's tie permutation for >16 ranges is implementation-defined; revisit only if a multi-component corpus function with >16 members and multiple RETURN-ending blocks appears
